# measureInteraction

Runs `fn` in an event handler and names the interaction it belongs to, so the reports `onInteraction` sends carry `name`. The report measures from the input to the next paint: the Event Timing entry for this event, or, where none has arrived by the second animation frame after it (in a browser without Event Timing, or for an event quicker than 16 ms), the time from the event to that frame. Each labelled interaction is reported once. Returns what `fn` returns. Call it inside the handler: outside one, it times from the call, and says so in development. With no sink it only runs `fn`.

```tsx
import { measureInteraction } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/measure-interaction";
```

## Example

```tsx
<Button onClick={() => measureInteraction("open filters", () => setOpen(true))}>Filters</Button>
```

## Use instead when

- Use `onInteraction` instead to measure every interaction without naming it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |
| `fn` | `() => T` |

## Returns

`T`
